```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", echo = FALSE)
# the source register when built from the source tree (see methods.Rmd)
claims <- fleetcheck::read_claims(if (file.exists("../claims.yml")) "../claims.yml" else
  system.file("claims.yml", package = "fleetcheck"))
claims <- claims[claims$parasite == "vivax", ]
```

The *P. vivax* claims ask the same questions as those for
[*P. falciparum*](evidence.html), for a `get_parameters(parasite = "vivax")`
list. They use vivax's own transmission grid, EIR 0.3 to 30. Radical cure, by
primaquine and by tafenoquine, replaces chemoprevention, which
`malariasimulation` cannot run under vivax, and vaccines, for which it has no
vivax calibration. `malariasimulation`'s vivax model has no severe disease, so
there are no severe claims. Two claims are specific to vivax: relapse incidence
and the share of people carrying hypnozoites. The tier-3 site-file comparison is
not yet part of the vivax evidence.

`malariasimulation` 3.0.0 evaluates vivax relapses only on days when at least
one person is bitten, so on a day with no infectious bite anywhere the IBM loses
every relapse, where `fleet` keeps them. In the scenario suite's 10,000-person
runs such days are common under indoor residual spraying, and below an EIR of
about 0.14 whatever is deployed. `intervention-impact-pv` sets out the effect on
the comparison.

This page is generated from `claims.yml`. A claim's tier is the cost of
reproducing it; see [Methods](methods.html#tiers).

```{r scoreboard, results = "asis"}
# link_prefix = "" links each id to its own section on this page
cat(fleetcheck::scoreboard_md(claims, link_prefix = ""), sep = "\n")
```

```{r sections, results = "asis"}
cat(fleetcheck::claim_sections_md(claims), sep = "\n")
```
